citations.claim: At step 124 NS (N and S) show green while EW show red with wait 1, i.e. NS turned green 1s after EW green/yellow with no all-red clearance
At step 123 EW still yellow while emergency for S active, one second before abrupt switch to NS green
At step 122 EW green with no emergency active, showing normal phase just before preemption

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (events -> []); same 124 steps. Emergency preemption is what skips yellow/all-red, so without it the cycle stays normal and no violation occurs.

explanation: Emergency preemption for S fires during EW green/yellow and forces an immediate switch to NS green, skipping the required yellow duration and all-red clearance. Step 122 shows EW green, step 123 shows EW yellow with emergency active, step 124 shows NS green with EW red wait only 1s (0s all-red), violating all_red_clearance (and truncating yellow to 1s).

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: The east-west approaches show green in steps 121-122 and yellow for only step 123, then the north-south approaches are already green in step 124. There is no all-red gap between the conflicting greens, with the change happening in a single second.
